visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, dressed in an oversized light grey hoodie and blue jeans, is seated at a professional drum kit in an outdoor urban plaza. She holds wooden drumsticks and begins a high-energy performance, striking the snare drum and hi-hat with precise, forceful movements. Her facial expression is focused yet slightly playful as she looks towards the camera. (2) The camera maintains a medium shot at a slightly low angle, capturing her upper body and the majority of the drum set. As she plays, she frequently smiles and opens her mouth as if shouting or singing along to the rhythm. She exhibits significant upper body movement, swaying with the beat, while her hands move rapidly between the cymbals and toms. (3) The background consists of a crowd of onlookers standing behind a barrier or at a distance. They are dressed in casual outdoor clothing like parkas and jackets, suggesting a cool climate. Some members of the crowd are holding up smartphones to record the performance. The setting features large architectural pillars and bright artificial lighting from nearby storefronts. (4) Towards the end of the clip, she performs a dramatic flourish, raising one drumstick high into the air while continuing the beat with the other hand. Her movements become even more exaggerated and energetic as the performance reaches its peak. She maintains high eye contact with the lens, projecting a charismatic and confident stage presence until the video cuts.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy pop-rock arrangement featuring a prominent electric guitar riff and a driving bassline. A sharp, explosive snare hit occurs immediately, perfectly synchronized with the start of the musical phrase. The primary female vocal layer is high-pitched and shouts energetic interjections that match the upbeat tempo. (2) As the rhythmic complexity increases, multiple rapid drum fills across the tom-toms and frequent crashes on the cymbals create a dense, percussive texture. The spectral brightness is elevated by the high-frequency shimmering of the cymbals. The male singer's voice from the pre-recorded BGM provides a melodic counterpoint to the live percussion sounds. (3) A distinct 'thud' from the bass drum provides a powerful low-end foundation throughout the track. The female performer's shouting becomes more frequent and strained, indicating high physical exertion and emotional arousal. Background ambient noise is minimal, consisting of a faint, broadband urban hum that is mostly obscured by the loud musical signal. (4) The audio concludes with a series of heavy cymbal strikes and a final, sustained drum roll that builds in volume. The electric guitar in the BGM hits a final power chord that rings out before the recording stops. There is a noticeable but low-level cheering sound from the surrounding crowd that enters the mix briefly as the music fades.
